session.system_instruction: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES (no opening rule: the greeting is already in the history)
session.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions (function_declarations)

history: one session carries the conversation: the opening seeded as client content, caller turns as realtime input, tool results as tool responses; a new session seeded with the kept history opens after an erasure; the history starts with reference_bot_settings.CONNECTED as the caller's first turn: '(The call has connected. Say your greeting.)'
turn: activity_start, the caller's audio as audio/pcm;rate=24000 blobs, activity_end (automatic activity detection off)
reply: the output audio transcription; a turn may take up to 90 s, since the extended-thinking model reasons between spoken chunks
session_per_caller_turn: one session across turns, as the voice bot runs it; a new one, seeded with the kept history, after an erasure or a dropped session
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
